1.explanation: This example sets up a Carbon DataTable with three rows and six columns. A TableToolbarSearch filters rows by any cell value. After filtering (e.g. searching for “Load Balancer 1”), only 1 row is visible. However, clicking the TableSelectAll checkbox in the header still toggles selection on all original rows (3), demonstrating the bug: the select-all action ignores the current filter and always applies to the full dataset.
1.bug_scenario: After applying a toolbar search filter to the DataTable (for example, filtering down to a single row), clicking the “Select All” checkbox in the table header still selects every row in the original data set (3 rows), rather than only the rows that remain visible after filtering (1 row).
